title: Excellent value for money with friendly staff and a clean, comfortable place to stay.
positiveText: The place was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. The staff were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and accommodating throughout my stay. The location was convenient, and it was definitely worth the price I paid. I would happily stay here again.

positiveText: I liked the cleanliness and excellent service staff especially Stella who made checking in and everything else run smoothly..

The check in process was quick and easy, and the staff were responsive and super helpful. The room was tidy, spacious and comfortable. Alona and the team were a great help and made my stay very comfortable.

title: Extraordinary!!!
positiveText: This is my 2nd time staying at the hotel. I initially chose the hotel because of the location. But the help of the staff, specially Shella at reception made the journey very pleasant. We didn’t have to worry about check-in or check-out. They took care of everything and we could just enjoy our stay. I plan on coming back again here for my next vacation!
Location, atmosphere, great service from Shella.

title: Exceptionally Pleasant
positiveText: The staff is very friendly, specially Shella at reception made this experience very pleasant. We reached early, our room was not yet available so she upgraded us to a better room just to make it convenient for us. The location is another key factor. It’s only 20 minutes to the CBD by public transport which is available every 7 minutes. That’s great value for the price you would pay!

negativeText:
The worse hostel I have stayed in during 8 months of travelling. 
Room was filthy. 
Difficult check in procedure despite already checking in online. Still took the staff 10mins when giving a room code which didn't work, then another 20 mins to solve this issue. We were then told we were upgraded due to being unable to access first room. The "upgrade" was half the size of the original room and was filthy. 
Also a strong smell of gas in courtyard.
And alarm constantly going off.
Staff not helpful when contacted.
